description: Renovate covers the three dependency surfaces of this repo: GitHub Actions, pip requirements and Dockerfile base images. It supersedes Dependabot, which watched GitHub Actions only.

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions updates into one PR. Actions stay SHA-pinned with their trailing version comments: config:recommended keeps digest pinning for github-actions, and Renovate updates the digest and the comment together.

Group pip updates for requirements.txt and requirements-test.txt (both matched by the pip_requirements manager's default file patterns). The files use version ranges, so these PRs are mostly range-widening and vulnerability-driven.
Group base image updates for the Dockerfile stages.
